headline: Ankle-to-thigh SE on the good angle, cross-on wind — dawn log or skip.
today: Same story as Rockaway, a touch smaller. Prime SE angle but only 1.7ft tops and cross-on to onshore wind after a brief 6mph E cross in the morning. Log it early around the low or find something better to do. Nothing here worth planning around.

daysToWatch.note: Bumps up to 2.1ft on a good SSE angle with a light 6mph dawn cross — the cleanest small window of the week here before it goes onshore.
